title: Questions, answers and missing information
intro: Each question needs an answer before a decision can be made reasonably. 'Answered' means the answer is in an official source. 'Open' needs your input or a manual check.

rows.question: Which city or cities? (Michelin cluster and base)
rows.answer: Not stated. Shanghai was used as a test cluster because it has a large official Michelin list (156 restaurants).
rows.how_to_close: Your choice: Shanghai, Beijing, Hong Kong, Hainan (Sanya/Haikou), or other.

rows.question: How many nights, and which dates?
rows.answer: The preferred window (15–18 Feb) is 3 nights. The requirement is a 7-night price, so either 15–22 Feb or another 7-night window.
rows.how_to_close: Confirm one of: 15–22 Feb (7 nights), or 15–18 Feb (3 nights, price shown per night).

rows.question: Can a US passport holder enter China for a normal sightseeing trip without a visa?
rows.answer: Not as a standard tourist. The 240-hour transit rule needs an onward ticket to a third country or region and a 10-day maximum. Hainan has a 30-day visa-free rule that includes the US. Nationwide 30-day status is unverified.
rows.how_to_close: Check with the Chinese embassy or consulate; re-check NIA's nationwide 30-day list.

rows.question: Will the Spring Festival holiday overlap the trip?
rows.answer: No. The official holiday is 5–13 Feb 2027 and 14 Feb is a working day. The trip starts on Mon 15 Feb.
rows.how_to_close: Re-check the State Council notice in case of changes.

rows.question: Which hotels meet the requirements (private bath, queen or larger, two adults)?
rows.answer: No verified hotel rows yet. Room and price data cannot be checked from here.
rows.how_to_close: Provide the hotel list you want checked, or allow a manual check on the hotel sites and booking platforms.

rows.question: What is the cheapest time to book a hotel?
rows.answer: No price history can be verified from here, so no booking window is recommended yet.
rows.how_to_close: Set up price tracking on a booking site once the hotel list is fixed; compare fares at several dates.

rows.question: Which Michelin restaurants are within 60 minutes by subway or bus of each hotel?
rows.answer: Needs hotel addresses and a route-time tool. Not yet done.
rows.how_to_close: Pick the hotels first, then compute journey times in a route planner.

rows.question: What are the current hours, prices and bookings for each Michelin restaurant?
rows.answer: The Michelin Guide pages could not be opened from here. Only star status is verified.
rows.how_to_close: Check each restaurant's official page or the Michelin Guide page manually.

rows.question: Which YouTube, TikTok or Instagram links exist for each place?
rows.answer: Only the Shanghai Museum's official links are listed (from its website). Other places were not searched.
rows.how_to_close: Search official accounts for each place and add links with sources.

rows.question: Do you want a 2-adult budget in CNY, USD, or both?
rows.answer: Not stated. Tables show what the sources give (CNY for Michelin averages, where verified).
rows.how_to_close: Choose one currency or dual display.

rows.question: What dates are your must-do activities (museums, gardens, etc.)?
rows.answer: Not stated. Both verified museum/garden venues are closed on Mondays.
rows.how_to_close: Tell us the activity list and the day you want for each.
